reviews.title: Bug Report
reviews.text:
Hello,

Since updating the Jump Jump app, I have been unable to use it. When I launch the app, the “J” logo appears for a few seconds, but then the app closes automatically and returns to the home screen.

I have already tried the following:
	•	Force closing and reopening the app
	•	Restarting my iPhone
	•	Checking available storage (more than 50 GB of free space available)
	•	Making sure I am using the latest version from the App Store

Device information:
	•	Device: iPhone XR
	•	iOS Version: 15.8.8

The app was working properly before the update. Please investigate this issue and let me know if there is a solution or if a fix is being developed.

Thank you for your support.
